title: Perry Richards analysis proof coverage
analytical_question: How much of each compiler-analysis mode's examined sites are provably optimized?
historical_method: Part-to-whole composition comparison using common 100% baseline; no historical inventor claimed
modern_method: Compare two fractions with slightly different denominators, showing proven/unproven complements

alternatives_considered.reason: Clear rate difference but does not make the unproven share as tangible
Might imply a change through time or a single evolving population, which this is not
Bar charts show magnitudes but 100% stack better highlights proof coverage and its complement

selected_reason: The analytical question is proportion proven out of examined sites, not counts or elapsed time. Aligned 0–100% stacks keep denominator context explicit.
attribution: Developer-reported internal benchmark, not independently replicated
caveat: Slightly different site populations and different analysis strategies; results are static proof coverage, not a runtime performance benchmark
accessibility_description: 100% stacked horizontal bars: per-unit 2.03% proven and 97.97% unproven, whole-program 91.32% proven and 8.68% unproven.
